description: Source code for CRM case management module in OpenERP/Odoo, defining classes, methods, and logic for handling cases, categories, rules, logs, and history.

classes.name: crm_case_section
classes.description: Represents sections of cases, with hierarchy and menu creation methods.

classes.name: crm.case.categ
classes.description: Represents categories of cases with probability and section association.

classes.name: crm.case.rule
classes.description: Defines rules for automating case state changes, notifications, and actions.

classes.name: crm.case
classes.description: Main class for managing individual cases, including creation, updates, status changes, and email notifications.

classes.name: crm.case.log
classes.description: Logs communication and actions related to cases.

classes.name: crm.case.history
classes.description: Tracks historical changes and communications for cases, inherits from crm.case.log.

methods.name: _action
methods.description: Executes rules to change case states and trigger notifications based on conditions.

methods.name: format_mail
methods.description: Prepares email content with case data for sending.

methods.name: email_send
methods.description: Sends email notifications related to cases.

methods.name: remind_user
methods.description: Sends reminder email to responsible user.

methods.name: case_close
methods.description: Marks a case as closed and triggers related actions.

methods.name: case_escalate
methods.description: Escalates a case to a higher section.

methods.name: case_reset
methods.description: Resets a case to draft state.
